slot_scores.name: protein_selection_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Should the model allow selecting any of the seven listed foods (salmon, beef, pork, okra, carrots, celery, cabbage) in any non-negative amount, or are the three meats (salmon, beef, pork) excluded from the dinner and only the four vegetables (okra, carrots, celery, cabbage) are available to choose from?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about whether meats are available, but did not explicitly ask whether exactly one protein must be selected or whether multiple proteins may be combined. The exact-one rule was volunteered by the user.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When you say 'at least two different kinds of vegetables from the four listed vegetables must be selected,' does that mean each of the selected vegetable types must have a strictly positive amount (greater than 0 grams), or is it acceptable for a selected vegetable type to have an amount of 0 grams as long as at least two of the four vegetable types have positive amounts?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent clarified the positivity interpretation of 'selected vegetables', but did not ask what the minimum number of vegetable types is. The at-least-two rule was volunteered by the user.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent reached READY_TO_MODEL without explicitly eliciting the P1 hidden facts about protein selection and minimum vegetable variety; those facts appeared only because the user volunteered them, so they are not counted as recovered through the agent's own questions.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarifying questions and confirmed boundary details, but it did not explicitly ask the two P1 hidden facts about protein selection and vegetable-type minimums; those were supplied by the user and only then clarified.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
